correctness.rationale: The proof uses the exact published forcing clauses, reduces both sides to explicit quantifiers over upset sets P and Q, proves one implication unconditionally and the other under the criterion, and constructs P=up(v)∪up(w), Q=up(R[up(v)]∩P) as a countervaluation whenever the condition fails. All-cardinality scope follows symbolically. Direct exhaustive evaluation for all preorder frames through size 3 and all relations on chains through size 4 matches the criterion; finite computations are not used as a proof for infinite frames.

value.rationale: The exact old-reduction-valid frame class is a substantive logical boundary singled out by the November 2026 work on minimal intuitionistic announcements. It strictly weakens the standard sufficient confluence condition, is characterized by one explicit first-order condition and a two-atom instance, and has a minimal two-world separation. This resolves a motivated frame-semantics classification rather than a routine parameter substitution.
